raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Fix undefined nonnegative lanes in the RISC-V RVV error-function implementations used by exact GELU and fused MoE GELU. Replace masked negation with sign injection in both FP32Vec8 and FP32Vec16.

## Claims

- Define every active erf output lane regardless of the implementation's mask-agnostic fill policy, while preserving the input sign, including negative zero.
- Extend the existing deterministic CPU GELU-and-multiply regression to cover exact and tanh variants.

## Validation

[Immutable reproduction sources, raw logs and provenance](https://github.com/luke-opus/vllm/tree/aa7fb87226c82d9964d7214dafc35b0adb6acf47/main-integration) compare upstream `e0d00e4b8eb0c89ec30921d0695cfdd409e9c211` with this independent fix. Execution used Ubuntu 24.04 RISC-V Linux/QEMU 11.1.2, RVV VLEN 256 with agnostic lanes filled with ones. This is not native-hardware or upstream-CI evidence.

| Check | Base | Fixed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Exact/tanh GELU regression | 2 failed, 2 passed; exact cases produce NaNs | 4 passed |
| Selected new standalone CPU block/input/sampling tests | 24 passed | 24 passed |

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -v -s tests/kernels/core/test_cpu_activation.py -k test_cpu_gelu_and_mul
```

[Repository tests](https://github.com/luke-opus/vllm/tree/aa7fb87226c82d9964d7214dafc35b0adb6acf47/main-integration/runtime/runs/main-repository-01) retain the real root conftest and fixtures. The same candidate tests run on the matching base/fixed headers and full libraries, with actual source/DSO paths, live maps and hashes checked. Baseline failures remain failures; there are no selected errors or skips. Actual exits and file/link restoration are independently recorded.

[Complete build records](https://github.com/luke-opus/vllm/tree/aa7fb87226c82d9964d7214dafc35b0adb6acf47/main-integration/build) show 21 production units rebuilt per base/ERF/BF16 variant (63 total), three full links and three real load/new-operator checks, all exiting 0. The 210 oneDNN units were reused after command/header/library identity checks. Identical environment adaptations use the recorded oneDNN declaration include, real LLVM OpenMP and the existing Torch BLAS fallback for the installed OpenBLAS's missing `sbgemm_`; no stub or replacement backend is used.

[Current-main model-route audit](https://github.com/luke-opus/vllm/tree/aa7fb87226c82d9964d7214dafc35b0adb6acf47/main-integration/source/erf-model-coverage-current-main.txt) did not identify an unchanged public checkpoint exercising the affected CPU/RVV gated exact-GELU route within its documented search scope. Dense/Torch GELU and Nomic's GELU_NO_MUL route do not establish this coverage. The separate Pythia BF16 smoke comparison is not ERF changed-path validation.

**Full manual pre-commit on Linux:** [this exact head's job](https://github.com/luke-opus/vllm/actions/runs/41283200026/job/124779155329) and the pinned baseline independently ran the unchanged official `uvx pre-commit run --show-diff-on-failure --color=always --all-files --hook-stage manual` command. All four source snapshots (base and three independent fixes) passed **33 selected manual hooks each**, with actual exit 0, no failed/skipped selected hooks, and empty final Git status/diff. [Immutable raw artifacts and identity checks](https://github.com/luke-opus/vllm/tree/490b210b51865ab11c10b14c6e0eaeec7820d475/main-integration/fork-precommit) verify the source commit/tree, original config hashes, runner identity and artifact digests. This is supplemental GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 24.04 x86-64 execution in the fork; it does not replace the upstream self-hosted eligibility gate or RISC-V hardware validation.

Local changed-file hooks, normal commit/sign-off hooks and full strict/API documentation builds passed. [Documentation preview](https://luke-opus.github.io/vllm/64078-main/getting_started/installation/cpu/) contains the default/enablement wording in this head; independent previews do not establish upstream RTD success. [Current-head CI audit](https://github.com/luke-opus/vllm/tree/aa7fb87226c82d9964d7214dafc35b0adb6acf47/main-integration/source/current-head-ci-audit.txt): DCO passed, but the upstream contributor-eligibility pre-run check failed, so format/lint checks were skipped. RTD's pre-run script also stopped on that check before dependency installation or MkDocs execution. CPU CI selection is included, while native RVV execution, upstream CI and the submitting human's review/test confirmation remain outstanding. This remains a draft.

Earlier-base evidence is retained separately in the evidence repository, including its warnings and limitations; it is not counted as execution of this new head.

## Details

The `_m` masked intrinsic uses a mask-agnostic policy. The old sign-restoration step only selected negative inputs, leaving nonnegative lanes without a passthrough value. `vfsgnj` copies the input sign to the computed magnitude and defines all active lanes.

Duplicate-work checks found no open `RISC-V erf` or `vfneg` fix. Related #51132 optimizes polynomial FMA evaluation and leaves this sign-restoration step unchanged.

AI assistance: OpenAI Codex. No human review or complete model validation is claimed.

---

- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.
- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [ ] **Testing and Validation:** Recorded comparisons and their limits are disclosed; native hardware, upstream CI and human confirmation remain outstanding. ERF changed-path model coverage remains unproved where applicable.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Applicable hooks and strict/API documentation builds pass; rendered documentation is updated in this head.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes the summary, evidence, reproduction commands, root cause, tradeoffs and AI disclosure.
</details>

files.patch:
@@ -161,6 +161,12 @@ VLLM_USE_PRECOMPILED=1 VLLM_PRECOMPILED_WHEEL_VARIANT=cpu VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu
 - Currently, vLLM CPU uses model default settings as `dtype`. However, due to unstable float16 support in torch CPU, it is recommended to explicitly set `dtype=bfloat16` if there are any performance or accuracy problem.  
 - On AMD Zen CPUs (`ZenCpuPlatform`), `float16` requires AVX512-FP16, available from Venice (6th Gen EPYC) onwards. On Turin (5th Gen EPYC) and earlier only `bfloat16` and `float32` are accepted, and models declared with `float16` are auto-downcast to `bfloat16` at model load time. See [AMD Zen optimizations](#amd-zen-optimizations).
 
+### Which GELU approximation is used on RISC-V?
+
+The RISC-V CPU backend supports both exact GELU (`approximate="none"`) and the tanh approximation (`approximate="tanh"`) for fused GELU-and-multiply operations. On RVV builds, the exact variant uses an error-function approximation that preserves every active lane, including nonnegative inputs, without depending on the processor's mask-agnostic fill policy.
+
+The model or operator selects the approximation; `GeluAndMul` defaults to `approximate="none"`. This fix preserves each model's existing selection and requires no new RISC-V CLI option or environment variable.
+
 ### How to launch a vLLM service on CPU?
 
 - When using the online serving, it is recommended to reserve 1-2 CPU cores for the serving framework to avoid CPU oversubscription. For example, on a platform with 32 physical CPU cores, reserving CPU 31 for the framework and using CPU 0-30 for inference threads:

@@ -113,10 +113,12 @@ def test_cpu_unary_activation(
 
 
 @pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", DTYPES)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("approximate", ["none", "tanh"])
 @torch.inference_mode()
-def test_cpu_gelu_tanh_and_mul(
+def test_cpu_gelu_and_mul(
     default_vllm_config,
     dtype: torch.dtype,
+    approximate: str,
 ) -> None:
     gate = torch.tensor(
         [
@@ -203,9 +205,12 @@ def test_cpu_gelu_tanh_and_mul(
 
     x = torch.cat((val, gate), dim=-1).contiguous()
     kernel_out = torch.empty_like(val)
-    torch.ops._C.gelu_tanh_and_mul(kernel_out, x)
+    if approximate == "none":
+        torch.ops._C.gelu_and_mul(kernel_out, x)
+    else:
+        torch.ops._C.gelu_tanh_and_mul(kernel_out, x)
 
-    torch_ref = torch.nn.functional.gelu(val, approximate="tanh") * gate
+    torch_ref = torch.nn.functional.gelu(val, approximate=approximate) * gate
 
     atol = get_default_atol(kernel_out)
     rtol = get_default_rtol(kernel_out)
